meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成微信个人号消息收发，无需付费Token
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将微信个人号接入自动化流程
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat personal account messaging without paid tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect WeChat personal account to automation workflows

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可通过微信个人号收发消息：用手机扫码登录，无需 API 密钥，通过长轮询实时接收。需先接线到 agent 组才能自动回复。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加微信频道或把个人微信接入 NanoClaw 时使用。流程含安装适配器、扫码登录和接线。

say.note: 开始执行添加微信的安装流程。

say.text: 启动微信服务并显示二维码
say.note: 修改配置并重启，输出扫码链接。

say.text: 把微信消息接上 agent 组
say.note: 运行接线脚本完成连接。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude can send/receive WeChat messages via a personal account. Login by scanning QR, no API keys, uses long-polling for real-time reception. Must be wired to an agent group before replying.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks to add a WeChat channel or connect a personal WeChat account to NanoClaw. Includes installing adapter, scanning QR, and wiring.

say_en.text: Start WeChat service and show QR
say_en.note: Updates config and restarts, outputs QR link.

say_en.text: Wire WeChat messages to agent group
say_en.note: Runs the wiring script to connect.
